summary: Frontend-only test of the Aerial & Solar page changes (subject-property highlight + job-card PV kWp banner). Logged in as it@cphretrofit.co.uk (httpOnly cookie login OK). Verified 4 Beeson Close (positive) and Coldrush (negative). All 3 requested cases pass.

issues: Spotlight vignette (rgba(8,12,20,0.34) box-shadow) is subtle on already-dark aerial imagery; ring + pin are clear, but the darkened surround is barely perceptible — consider ~0.45 opacity if stronger emphasis is desired. Cosmetic only, not a defect.

critical_code_review_comments: jobKwp regex on solarMeasure.name is sound (kWp then bare kW with negative lookahead); it correctly ignores 'Solar PV + Battery'. Note it would also match a name containing e.g. '2.4 kW inverter' — acceptable for current data.
